name: Nebula Storefront
description: A fictional multi-tier online shop. Traffic passes through a web firewall and load balancer to two frontend nodes, which call an order API backed by a relational database, a read replica and a session cache.

name: Stellar Media Pipeline
description: A fictional video workflow. Uploads land in a raw bucket, a job queue feeds a transcoder worker pool, and processed files are served to viewers through an edge cache. All buckets are encrypted with keys from a key vault.

name: Quasar Analytics Platform
description: A fictional analytics platform. Events are collected into a data lake, a nightly ETL cluster loads them into a warehouse, and a dashboard server lets analysts explore the results.

name: Orbit Internal Tools
description: A small fictional staff portal. Employees connect through a VPN, sign in with single sign-on, and use an HR portal backed by a database with nightly backups.
